sentences.en: One can classify books into good ones and bad ones.
sentences.zh: 1. 可以把书分为好书和坏书。

sentences.en: Did you read the classified ads in the newspaper today?
sentences.zh: 2. 你今天看了报纸上的分类广告了吗？

sentences.en: The congressional staffer who leaked classified documents has been arrested.
sentences.zh: 3. 泄露机密文件的国会助理已被逮捕。

senses.zh: 把…分类，把…分等级；把…列为
